alexnet.purpose: LPIPS AlexNet IMAGENET1K_V1 backbone; required in addition to the calibrated LPIPS head
alexnet.license_note: Consult torchvision and original model terms

lpips_alex.purpose: PyIQA LPIPS v0.1 AlexNet calibrated linear head

vgg16.purpose: DISTS VGG16 IMAGENET1K_V1 backbone; required in addition to the DISTS head

niqe_params.purpose: Original NIQE natural-image statistics; not a neural checkpoint but still a required local artifact

musiq_koniq.purpose: MUSIQ trained on KonIQ-10k; do not substitute AVA or SPAQ variants

clip_rn50.purpose: OpenAI CLIP RN50 used by plain CLIP-IQA; no CLIP-IQA+ learned prompt checkpoint

dover.purpose: Full DOVER; DOVER-Mobile is a different model

fastvqa.purpose: FAST-VQA B, fast-b.yml; do not substitute the Scr or M variants

raft_things.purpose: Original full RAFT Things checkpoint; use upstream download_models.sh manually and select models/raft-things.pth
raft_things.license_note: RAFT BSD-3-Clause; no flow weights included
